purpose: A category strip, lighter than tabs: no underline, just ink. The selected chip turns weight 450 and its width is reserved up front so neighbours never shift. Link chips mark the current category with aria-current="page"; button chips are single-select with aria-pressed and fire fd:change. It scrolls sideways and fades at the clipped edge.
useWhen: A catalogue, gallery or template list is narrowed by category.
There are more categories than a segmented control holds.

avoidWhen.when: The items switch views of one object.
There are two to five exclusive options.
The filters combine and apply together.

states.name: current
states.how: aria-current="page" on a link chip, or aria-pressed="true" on a button chip

parts.role: One category; a link or a button.

keyboard.does: Select a button chip; Enter follows a link chip.
